decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The current extension to the dwellinghouse of a gable end extending 4m from the existing hipped ridgeline, being 3m high and having a base width of 7.8m, with a volume of 15.44m3, as well as a rear dormer with dimensions of 3.7m deep, 3.1m high with a width of 5.8m, that adds 33.26m3 which together provide a total extension volume of 48.7m3 to the original dwellinghouse, qualifies as Class B permitted development within Part 1 of Schedule 2 of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 and therefore, does not require planning permission.

Condition : 2 - INFORMATIVE: 

The applicant is advised that the roof extension being constructed as part of this application must be fully completed before works begin on the single storey rear extension approved by Planning Application reference 00662/40/P1 granted on the 25th March 2004. If any work commences on the single-storey rear extension before completion of the roof extension, this Certificate of Lawfulness will be rendered invalid and the roof extension will require planning permission.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the retention of roof extension to dwellinghouse
